notes: Intake: the page states the winter semester deadline 'until 15 July' without a year, so the date is left null. Language: the programme is taught in both English and German; the stated language condition is B2 English or C1 German depending on the chosen language track. Application channel: for a Moroccan Baccalauréat holder this is via uni-assist; the pages describe uni-assist as the submission route, not a Vorprüfungsdokumentation (VPD), so 'de-uni-assist' is chosen.
